original_test_intent: Validate that BIOS isolates a channel after a DDR5 PMIC critical-temperature shutdown, logs the exact power/rank-disable warnings, boots with reduced memory, retains the PMIC event history and can be returned to a fully healthy state.
original_method: Capture platform/DIMM/PMIC identity, settings, logs and capacity; verify all PMIC status fields zero; inject approved raw0x82 to target PMIC and capture shutdown; perform one controlled AC cycle; analyze serial EWL0x46/0x5 and per-rank0xA/0x3, confirm two64GB DIMMs disabled and successful reduced-memory boot; read PMIC reg0x4=0x10 and reg0x5 critical-temp bit; preserve evidence, clear target status once and perform approved IFWI reflash or CMOS clear; verify full memory and health restored.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE validates PMIC silicon and raw command, controls shutdown/AC cycle and IFWI/CMOS recovery; the agent may capture PMIC, serial, EWL and memory-inventory evidence.

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain exact PMICErrorStatus, one `injectPMICError(...raw_value=0x82)`, controlled AC cycle, serial/EWL/capacity checks, PMIC history reread and owner-approved `clearPMICErrorStatus` plus IFWI/CMOS recovery.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Socket0/MC0/ch0/slot0, raw0x82, register/EWL values, two64GB DIMMs, Common branch and30/30 minutes are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Exercise one vendor-approved PMIC critical-temperature shutdown and correlate persistent PMIC history with BIOS isolation and exact recovery to full memory.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable evidence preservation, explicit power/firmware interlocks, timeouts and full-topology restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful injection command or SEL entry cannot prove the intended PMIC isolation, EWL decoding or recoverability.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The command intentionally powers off and persists a fault history; unsupported PMIC revisions may behave differently, and failed IFWI/CMOS recovery can leave memory disabled or the SUT unbootable.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row178 Wistron-System RAS-00135-V001: approve GNR/BIOS/BMC/IFWI/OS, DIMM/PMIC PN/vendor/revision and CScripts version/hash/license; confirm raw0x82 reg0x35 semantics, promotion/isolation/secure/POR mappings, exact EWL0x46/0x5 and0xA/0x3 plus two64GB capacity oracle, controlled AC/POST/boot timeouts, PMIC0x4/0x5 decoder, and the one-time clearPMICErrorStatus plus signed IFWI or CMOS recovery/restoration to full memory.

review_improvement: Restores the source PMIC register, serial EWL, memory-isolation and persistent recovery coverage, and prevents generic logs or unapproved clearing/flashing from masking a failed isolation flow.
independent_technical_reasoning: Raw0x82 is meant to latch a critical-temperature shutdown in the target PMIC, so the immediate power loss is only the stimulus. The actual isolation behavior is established after AC restart: BIOS must decode register0x05, emit the critical power warning, disable every rank on the target channel and boot with the corresponding capacity loss. Registers0x4/0x5 prove persistence rather than a transient shutdown. Because BIOS remembers disabled DIMMs, clearing only the PMIC register is insufficient; the approved IFWI/CMOS reset and restored full inventory close the test safely.
